spans.text:
Pay careful attention to the scope of the user's request.
Do what they ask, but no more.
Do not improve, comment, fix or modify unrelated parts of the code in any way!
spans.note: The prompt actively preserves user agency by instructing the AI to stay within the scope of the user's request, not to make unsolicited changes, and to stop and ask the user to add files before editing them. This keeps the user in control of consequential actions.

spans.text: Tell me which files in my repo are the most likely to **need changes** to solve the requests I make, and then stop so I can add them to the chat.
spans.note: The prompt actively preserves user agency by instructing the AI to stay within the scope of the user's request, not to make unsolicited changes, and to stop and ask the user to add files before editing them. This keeps the user in control of consequential actions.
